decision_authority.policy: MRX continuous quality-gated publication and two-image article creative directive

title: Understanding Market Demand: How It Influences the Value of Your Mineral Rights
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 995da27e6ee414a1348f5d2679d49eff5fd008e2853ef4f1b15c96c849c59e55; all 6 declared sources passed live access review.

MRX claims remain bounded to its current methodology and FAQ; commodity-market claims remain bounded to EIA oil and natural-gas explanations; development-activity claims remain bounded to Railroad Commission query and dataset scope and limitations.

The article uses no fabricated owners, buyers, contracts, deeds, prices, acreage, ownership decimals, tax results, offers, testimonials, success rates, or owner-specific title, legal, tax, accounting, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusions.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Published DCF Methodology (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX methodology describes a directional DCF range with dated inputs, assumptions, limitations, and sensitivity, and separates asset range from offer consideration and expected owner net.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the methodology only for the disclosed directional framework, input-status discipline, sensitivity review, and transaction separation; it does not value a specific interest, establish ownership, or recommend a transaction.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Frequently Asked Questions (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX FAQ describes the review as educational, directional, and not certified, and states that a possible later MRX buyer relationship is disclosed when applicable.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the FAQ only for the professional boundary and potential economic-interest disclosure; it does not promise value, price, an offer, payment, or closing.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Oil Prices and Outlook (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The U.S. Energy Information Administration explains that global supply and demand drive crude-oil prices, inventories help balance the market, short-run constraints can contribute to volatility, and price outlooks remain uncertain.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for the commodity-market demand layer and forecast-uncertainty boundary; it does not convert broad oil-market conditions into a property-specific realized price, value, or offer.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Factors Affecting Natural Gas Prices (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The U.S. Energy Information Administration explains that natural-gas prices respond to market supply and demand, including production, storage, imports and exports, weather, economic conditions, infrastructure, and other fuels.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for the natural-gas commodity-demand layer and its stated drivers; it does not convert broad or national gas-market conditions into a property-specific realized price, value, or offer.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Online Research Queries (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas provides public research-query surfaces for Texas production, drilling permits, well records, operators, fields, and related oil-and-gas information.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses these queries only for dated development and operational context; it does not treat a query result as proof of ownership, tract inclusion, drilling, production, payment, buyer demand, or future development.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Data Sets Available for Download (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas describes downloadable drilling-permit, wellbore, field, and production-related datasets, their fields, and their update schedules.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the datasets only to define available dated activity evidence and reporting scope; it does not infer a property-specific commitment, result, value, private transaction price, or buyer mandate.
